name: Inma Musume
source:
Night after night the succubus milked my sperm until finally, we made a lovechild.
I was told to raise it, in exchange for which she would free me from my torturous sex sessions, but...

How am I supposed to raise a little succubus baby? I sympathize that she's born into dark modern times, and want to raise her the right way, but... Language, maths, cooking, social studies, and the very important one... sex and health.

Choose her subjects and see your demon daughter change, and your relationship change with her.
